name: Robert B. Thompson
role: Church clerk and scribe in Nauvoo
dateNote: Section 124, dated 19 January 1841, praises him; he died in Nauvoo that August.
importance: Robert B. Thompson was an English Methodist who joined in Upper Canada in 1836. As Church clerk in 1840–41, he copied section 124 into the Book of the Law of the Lord. That revelation tells him to help write a proclamation to the rulers of the earth. He became associate editor of the Times and Seasons and died on 27 August 1841.
connections: He married Mercy Rachel Fielding in 1837, making him a brother-in-law of Hyrum Smith.

sources.title: Robert Blashel Thompson, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates and roles checked on JSP. The brother-in-law link rests on Hyrum Smith’s marriage to Mary Fielding, which is general knowledge, not on the JSP page.
